site.name: Aurum Interiors
site.tagline: Designing spaces that feel like home.

hero.subtitle: Bespoke interiors crafted with soul — from concept sketches to the final cushion, we take care of everything in between.

about.heading: Where Vision Meets Craftsmanship
about.text1: Aurum Interiors is a full-service design studio founded on a simple belief: great interiors should feel personal. We blend contemporary aesthetics with timeless warmth, tailoring every project to the way you actually live.
about.text2: From 1BHK apartments to sprawling villas, our team handles design, execution and styling end-to-end — so you never have to chase a contractor again.

services.heading: Our Services
services.subheading: One studio, every skill you need to build a beautiful home.

items.title: Residential Interiors
items.text: Complete home interiors — living rooms, bedrooms and beyond — designed around your daily rituals.

items.title: Modular Kitchens
items.text: Ergonomic, handle-free modular kitchens with premium finishes and smart storage in every inch.

items.title: Office & Commercial
items.text: Workspaces and retail interiors that boost productivity and reflect your brand identity.

items.title: Lighting Design
items.text: Layered lighting plans — ambient, task and accent — that transform how your space feels after dark.

items.title: Custom Furniture
items.text: Bespoke sofas, wardrobes and statement pieces made to order by our in-house craftsmen.

items.title: Space Styling
items.text: Accessorising, art placement and final styling that gives your space that lived-in magazine look.

portfolio.heading: Our Portfolio
portfolio.subheading: A glimpse of the spaces our clients now call home.

items.name: Karthik Rao
